IN PLAIN ENGLISH

Words should
open doors.

A small glossary for the next conversation.

Cash flow +

The movement of money in and out over a period of time.

Liquidity +

How readily something can be converted into cash without a substantial change in its value.

Opportunity cost +

What you give up when you choose one option over another.
